cohort: 583,571 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies at 24-42 weeks gestation
finding: Older maternal age (≥30 years) was independently associated with various adverse pregnancy outcomes, including PIH, GDM, caesarean delivery, preterm birth, LGA, and low Apgar score.
mod_finding: Older nulliparous women were more likely to experience caesarean delivery, preterm birth, and 5-min Apgar score <7 compared to older multiparous women.
